name: Seed Junky Prepackaged Flower | Tropical Burst
description: Tropical Burst is a bright sativa that has the aroma of tropical citrus and creamy dough. The smell and taste of this strain have a near perfect translation to each other. Tropical Burst strain has powerful mouth coating citrus flavor and aroma, giving creative inspiration and a euphoric high to start the day.
